_about: Test feed for the Scout crawler (json_api source, hints.itemsPath = "jobs"). Fictional listings; pay is in cents. Items 8–10 are meant to be rejected or quarantined.

jobs.title: Weekend café helper
jobs.description: Help bus tables, restock pastries and keep the counter tidy on Saturday and Sunday mornings. Friendly team, training provided, free drink every shift.

jobs.title: Garden center seasonal helper
jobs.description: Water plants, arrange flower displays and help customers carry purchases to their cars during our spring rush. Outdoor work, sunscreen recommended.

jobs.title: Youth soccer assistant referee
jobs.description: Run the sidelines as an assistant referee for under-8 and under-10 games on Saturday mornings. Free certification course before the season starts.

jobs.title: Summer reading buddy
jobs.description: Read with kids aged 5 to 8 during the library's summer reading program. Two afternoons a week, counts toward school service hours.

jobs.title: Ice cream scooper
jobs.description: Scoop cones, make sundaes and keep the shop clean on summer afternoons and early evenings. Must be friendly and comfortable handling a register.

jobs.title: Car wash attendant
jobs.description: Guide cars onto the track, pre-rinse wheels and towel-dry vehicles at the exit. Weekend shifts, tips shared by the whole crew.

jobs.title: Pool snack bar helper
jobs.description: Serve snacks and drinks at the outdoor pool's snack bar, restock the cooler and keep the patio clean. Afternoon shifts June through August.

jobs.title: Brewery taproom busser
jobs.description: Clear tables and wash glasses in our brewery taproom on Friday and Saturday evenings.

jobs.title: Overnight warehouse stocker
jobs.description: Overnight shifts restocking shelves in our warehouse. Text me for details and to set up a start date.
